text: A wave of brutal suicides begins in the United States and [spreads all over the earth|wants|spreading and taking over]. In a small town, a man kills himself after spending long hours at his computer, and soon his friends start [receiving e-mails from the dead man|images|pictures, screens and recordings]. They begin [seeing strange creatures around them|threat|monsters and creatures], and the deaths are only the beginning of a coming doomsday.
